verdict.rationale: Airweave's official MCP server lets AI assistants search synced data, and its official skills cover Cursor and Claude Code, so several off-the-shelf tools can query the same collection. Community reports corroborate that it works with Cursor. However, the shared store is data synced from connected apps, not a memory that assistants write to. Nothing shows a tool recording what it learns about the user so other tools can read it. Missing for 10: assistants writing or updating shared user memory, explicit ChatGPT support, a documented cross-assistant shared-memory workflow, and hands-on corroboration across multiple assistants.
